items.title: GDDY Q3 deep dive: Airo adoption, margin expansion, and AI-driven transformation
items.summary: Domain registrar and web services company GoDaddy (NYSE:GDDY) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with sales up 6% year on year to $1.34 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $5.24 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.56 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: What Does GoDaddy (GDDY) Securities Lawsuit Mean For Its Growth Story?
items.summary: GoDaddy (NYSE:GDDY) faces a new securities lawsuit alleging misleading disclosures about its go-to-market strategy for .com domains. Plaintiffs claim GoDaddy used promotional discounts on .com domains without fully revealing possible pressure on bookings and overall growth metrics. The complaint argues that management mischaracterised how its sales approach targeted high-intent customers and the related business risks.
